The [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Check whether text reads the same forwards and backwards. Enter your text and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like. It is one of the [Text Tools tools](/tools?category=Text%20Tools) on CalcHub — the others work the same way.

Check whether text reads the same forwards and backwards. This free online palindrome checker gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Palindrome Checker

Start by typing or pasting your text. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Type or paste your text.
2. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
3. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Ignore spaces, punctuation and letter case, then compare the text with its reverse.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama is a palindrome after normalisation. Try the same figures in the [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. The steps are the same whatever numbers you use; only the figures change.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Text: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama), the [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) returns Result: Yes — it is a palindrome, Normalised text: amanaplanacanalpanama. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. Change any value and every figure updates instantly. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Word Counter](/word-counter) is worth a look before you finish.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is this palindrome checker free?

Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or installation required. There is no limit on how often you use it, nothing to install, and no account to create — open the [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) and start straight away.

### Are my entries stored?

No. Calculations run in your browser and the tool does not save your entries. You can use it as often as you like, and because nothing is uploaded, stored or tracked, there is nothing to delete afterwards.

### What formula does the Palindrome Checker use?

Ignore spaces, punctuation and letter case, then compare the text with its reverse. You can see it in action in the [Palindrome Checker](/palindrome-checker) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.

### What do I need to use the Palindrome Checker?

Just Text. Enter those values and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. If you are unsure about a value, try a rough figure first and then refine it — the result updates instantly.
